sentences.text: The dataset records federal contributions of up to $30M to Halagonia Tidal Energy under the Emerging Renewable Power Program.
The agreement is associated with the Bay of Fundy in-stream tidal demonstration site.
The project proponent has published a notice indicating the demonstration project will not proceed to the deployment phase as originally scoped.
The Natural Resources Canada Departmental Results Report for fiscal 2023–24 lists the program but does not report performance against the deployment target for this site.
The Province of Nova Scotia retains its tidal demonstration framework; no provincial contribution to this specific recipient is recorded in the open dataset.

unverifiable.rationale: The open contributions dataset shows agreement-level commitments and amendments but does not reconcile to a final disposition statement; the most recent DRR for the program does not provide a project-level reconciliation.
